intent: Recover the exact Android HOME resolver after installing the instrumentation fixture only when bounded read-only enumeration proves the fixture and stock launcher candidates, retaining the existing readiness deadline, barriers and one-shot mutation/readback contract.

confirmed_evidence.head: c980ad3b4c13f8d9dd8bb4b5a393f4263d3b197f
confirmed_evidence.origin: Parent inspection of the exact-head API34 CI artifact
confirmed_evidence.observation: android/com.android.internal.app.ResolverActivity persisted for the 60-second readiness window; ROLE_HOME was not set; the test APK installed and instrumentation never began.
confirmed_evidence.local_source: Discovery only accepts a stock launcher or TEST_HOME before the later set-home selection, so this exact resolver cannot advance.
confirmed_evidence.parent_retry: Parent reports the existing c980 API34 single failed-job retry passed 55 tests; this fix addresses the separately reproduced setup deadlock and does not reinterpret the original failed attempt.

upstream_command_contract.source: AOSP PackageManagerShellCommand.java in android-14.0.0_r1 and android-16.0.0_r1
upstream_command_contract.contract: query-activities --components emits one flattened component per line, or No activities found; --brief alone also prints metadata/headers.

constraints: Require exact TEST_HOME and at least one stock launcher; unknown, fallback, missing, duplicate or malformed candidates cannot authorize selection.
All read-only discovery consumes the original finite <=60-second deadline.
No changes to ANR/crash detection, barriers, display settling, package disabling, mutation retries or instrumentation acceptance.

baseline.result: New positive resolver behavior test fails against unchanged production script with bounded TimeoutError before any mutation.

canonical_fast.inventory: Temporarily regenerated for checks then restored exactly; combined generated inventory remains parent-owned.

validation.device: No local Android SDK/adb or emulator execution; updated exact-head Android CI remains required. Host fixture/native diagnostic messages are test data, not device qualification.

implementation.entry: Only the exact Android ResolverActivity invokes query-activities --components --user 0 for MAIN/HOME.
implementation.candidate_validation: At most 16 unique component lines and 8192 characters; exact TEST_HOME, at least one stock allowlisted launcher, and no other candidates. Missing or boot fallback/unknown candidates are observed read-only within the original deadline. Malformed/duplicate/oversized output fails before mutation.
implementation.preserved: Original finite <=60-second deadline; transient read-only transport retry only; installed-fixture check; broadcast/process barriers; one set-home call; exact readback and successful launch; ANR reporting and display settling unchanged.
implementation.report: Successful resolver recovery records the exact accepted HOME candidate list.
